name: Clarissa’s Divine Dome
body:
School necromancy; Level cleric/oracle 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Effect dome with a radius of up to 5 ft. per two levels
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

A dome of shimmering holy light surrounds the area with positive energy. This dome does not hinder objects passing through it and does not block line of sight. Undead creatures that pass through the dome sustain 1d8 points of damage per caster level (to a maximum of 10d8). Undead creatures that pass a Will save take half damage. Living creatures passing through the wall are unharmed.
